title: North Axis — Versioned Membership / Relationship History
status: mixed conversation-recovered project history; primary-source recovery pending for some states
purpose: Preserve how the user's North geography changed over time instead of flattening changing formulations into one timeless membership list.
rule: This is not a legal alliance membership registry. It records project formulations and relationship status. Real EU, NATO, EEA and treaty memberships must be sourced separately.

status_vocabulary.core: explicitly central participant in the project formulation
status_vocabulary.inner_network: strongly connected but not necessarily anchor/core
status_vocabulary.under_axis: within the broader North field without being a primary anchor
status_vocabulary.strategic_extension: important terminal/gate/extension of the working arc
status_vocabulary.external: important relationship but outside the working North membership
status_vocabulary.future_reconnection: outside now but contemplated for later relational reconnection
status_vocabulary.shared_or_cross_axis: not exclusively assigned to North; linked across fields

snapshots.provenance: conversation-recovered broad formulation; exact source dates still to recover
snapshots.note: This reconstructed version treats the North as a relational civilizational/economic network, not empire or annexation.
Country naming varied between sovereign states and constituent nations; preserve exact historical language while also maintaining canonical sovereign-state nodes.

snapshots.provenance: user-stated formulation recovered from conversation memory
snapshots.headline: Canada -> Turkey minus England
snapshots.scale_note: Population-scale headline requires a dated membership definition and recalculation before use as empirical demographic fact.

canonical_current_model.european_field: European states and institutions are represented by relationship strength and function rather than forced binary membership.
variable_nodes: United Kingdom / England / Scotland status must remain versioned

normalization_rules: Store sovereign-state identity separately from the user's exact constituent-nation wording.
Never silently convert Scotland or England into independent-state membership claims; record the user's formulation and the real constitutional identity side by side.
Do not infer membership from geographic proximity.
Do not infer political consent from project inclusion.
Every later membership change adds a new snapshot rather than rewriting an older one.
Where a number such as approximately 900M is used, preserve the exact snapshot from which it was derived and recompute from authoritative population data before empirical presentation.
research_targets: Recover exact first use of 'North Axis' as organized geopolitical programme in February 2026.
Recover each explicit country-list statement with exact date and wording.
Recover when England changed from included to pending/excluded and whether UK and England were distinguished.
Recover Russia status changes: included, excluded, external, future reconnection.
Recover the first explicit 'Canada -> Turkey' formulation.
Recover the source and calculation behind approximately 850M then approximately 900M population headlines.
Recover Estonia's 'under the North Axis' wording and determine whether other Baltic states received the same classification.
Recover the exact meaning of Australia being 'shared'.
Recover the Mesopotamia/Iraq/Syria future-link formulation and distinguish cultural-civilizational linkage from programme membership.
